#  Title:Anomalous changing of geodesics in hairy black holes
Authors:[Weyner Ccuiro](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Ccuiro,+W), [David Choque](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Choque,+D), [Gustavo Valdivia-Mera](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Valdivia-Mera,+G)
View a PDF of the paper titled Anomalous changing of geodesics in hairy black holes, by Weyner Ccuiro and 1 other authors
[View PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2111.04800) [HTML (experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2111.04800v4)
> Abstract:We study the motion of test particles and the propagation of light around neutral hairy black holes under the influence of a self-interacting real scalar field minimally coupled to gravity. The goal of the present work is to show that the time-like and null-like geodesics have an anomalous behaviour for a special range of parameters in the dense hair region, defined as \sqrt{\Omega(x_{h})}\leq r\leq 2MG_{N}/c^{2}.
